basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco’s Ingleside neighborhood, this home is a fully renovated single-family home that perfectly combines classic charm with modern upgrades. Originally built in 1907, this residence has been thoughtfully redesigned to meet contemporary living needs, including the addition of a permitted Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) completed in 2023.  This home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 elegantly designed bathrooms, offering a versatile and comfortable layout. The open-concept design showcases soaring cathedral ceilings, skylights, and abundant natural light. The chef’s kitchen is equipped with sleek quartz countertops, premium stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry, while an attached deck provides a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience, perfect for entertaining or relaxation.  The property also includes a private, income-producing ADU with a separate entrance, a fully equipped kitchenette, and a modern bathroom. This space is ideal for rental income, guest accommodations, or multi-generational living.  This is a rare opportunity to own a turn-key property with both functional design and excellent investment potential.
